notes: IKEA Japan (jp/ja market). Access: tier-1 direct HTTP fetch throughout, no blocks. Homepage main nav includes a dedicated '新商品をチェック！' (Check New Products!) entry linking to https://www.ikea.com/jp/ja/new/new-products/ with a 'すべての新商品を見る' (View all new products) call-to-action confirming it is the full listing, not a curated homepage teaser. On-page hero copy: '7月は550点以上の新商品が登場！' (Over 550 new products arrived in July!) -- a real 'recently added to catalogue' framing, not a themed campaign/lookbook. Confirmed genuine PLP: page <title>/breadcrumb both read '新商品' (New Products), and the page has a full product grid plus standard product-type facet filters (調理器具・食器/Cookware & Tableware, ソファ/Sofas, 収納家具/Storage Furniture, テーブル・チェア/Tables & Chairs, 小物収納/Small Storage, ベッド/Beds, ラグ・クッション・寝具/Rugs Cushions & Bedding, インテリア雑貨/Interior Accessories, 照明/Lighting, ベビー＆子ども/Baby & Children) -- these are ordinary cross-cutting product-type facets applied within the one New Products listing (the same facet pattern IKEA uses on every category page), not site-exposed 'New Arrivals > Furniture New Arrivals' sub-PLPs, so kept as a single row rather than invented sub-categories. No separate '新着'/'新商品' listing found elsewhere in nav, footer, or the /offers/ hub. Qty verified two ways on the same fetch: rendered ARIA product-count text '871アイテム' (871 items) and embedded JSON 'totalCount':871 -- both agree.
